assessments.reasoning: The Index’s docs/SCOPE.md at cdff8aeed68bf1f9c62d8c86159c7dc08b2d75d7 defines a license exception as an additional permission or documented modification to a base license and requires separate support for the affected editions. The Totem header explicitly supplies both the additional permission and its GPL version 2 or later context. The taxonomy supplies the kind criterion only.

The complete GNOME/totem src/totem.h at a15e486a6b50b80b782af1cb896a70fa5d200024 has the captured SHA-256 99c9c10f0da56255db69ae6bd27dd63882f689ac52f5e66500f70450d96737bf. The opening comment names the Totem project as grantor, specifies use and distribution together with both named programs, and calls the permission additional to the GPL. A separate comment dates the clause addition to February 7, 2005.

The Index decision dated 2026-11-26 at commit 318db58e06be8f6682a6cb1520f0300df7ebd2c4 lists permanent entity 129ad14748f84175a109042fa3455d0d, the opaque ID in subject e-129ad14748f84175a109042fa3455d0d. The digest matches the publisher header capture.

That ID matches the separately inspected annotated object. This establishes the first link in the edition provenance at inspection time.

The GNOME/totem API record for d567bad46355faef72f0e1c8ac82068a5bba6cfe names V_1_0_5 and gives its target type as commit with ID a15e486a6b50b80b782af1cb896a70fa5d200024, exactly the revision in the raw header URL. challenge.method: Tested whether the neighboring 2008 Index row could supply the specimen or lifecycle for the 2005 claim. Also checked whether the release ref pointed directly to the source commit and whether the tag carried a verified signature.
challenge.results: The active 2008 row identifies entity c5c10dee8ecf4f79a74641f03f23006f, edition totem-43-0-copying, and a different digest. Substituting it fails the identity, edition and revision checks. The 2005 ref points to an annotated tag object whose commit target matches the header URL. The API explicitly reports the tag as unsigned. No material contradiction remains for the scoped documentary claim.

limitations: The Index retains historical references for reconciliation and documentary lookup after selection. Its decision establishes neither publisher currency nor SPDX deprecation. Consumer dataset publication requires separate release authorization.

The permission concerns the named plugins together with GStreamer and Totem. Applying it to a particular work or distribution requires separate evidence. The GStreamer library’s LGPL status and the status of other program files are outside this header’s evidentiary scope.
The later GStreamer FAQ example is a separate specimen. Its wording was not independently inspected in this review.
The tag reference, annotated tag and header share one GNOME/totem repository lineage. The tag is unsigned, so the recorded tagger attribution lacks cryptographic confirmation.
reasoning: GNOME’s Totem 1.0.5 tag resolves to the exact commit containing the cited src/totem.h. Its header grants permission for non-GPL-compatible GStreamer plugins to be used and distributed together with GStreamer and Totem, in addition to the stated GPL version 2 or later terms. The License Index taxonomy admits that additional permission as an exception. Its separately pinned decision assigns the exact 2005 header the documentary name “GStreamer Exception (2005)” and the lifecycle value “historical”.
